abilities.name: CHAMELEON AMBUSH
abilities.effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: VENGEANCE OF AZYR
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with a friendly SAURUS unit to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: SCALED AEGIS
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SAURUS unit to be the target
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has WARD (6+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: FOLLOWERS OF HUANCHI
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly SKINK unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s ranged weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn, including Companion weapons.

abilities.name: INSTINCTIVE COMMANDER
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general and not in combat to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

abilities.name: VENOMITE SWARM
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: If your general’s Venomites token is on the battlefield, roll a D3. On a 1, remove that token from the battlefield. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

abilities.name: SAVAGE MAULING
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: BLESSED BY THE OLD ONES
abilities.declare: Your general must use this ability if it has been destroyed. Roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, you can set up a replacement unit with 1 Sunblood model anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: SCALED PROTECTORS
abilities.effect: While this unit includes a Sunblood, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit each phase and add 1 to this unit’s control score.

abilities.name: SAVAGE BELLOW
abilities.declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 3+, the target’s weapons have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn, including Companion weapons. KEYWORDS HERO, INFANTRY

abilities.name: ORDERED COHORTS
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is contesting an objective you control. KEYWORDS INFANTRY

abilities.name: STAR-VENOM
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s Dartpipe to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn. KEYWORDS INFANTRY ezstandalone.cmd.push(function() {ezstandalone.showAds(122)});

abilities.name: NERVE-SHREDDING SCREECHES
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn. KEYWORDS BEAST, FLY, REINFORCEMENTS

abilities.name: SUN ACOLYTES
abilities.effect: This unit has a crew of 3 Sun Acolytes that are tokens. Add 1 to this unit’s control score for each Sun Acolyte it has. If this unit has no Sun Acolytes, it has a maximum control score of 1. Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its Sun Acolytes from the battlefield after the Attack ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted). KEYWORDS BEAST
